headline: 25 notable citizen-written complaints this week in Austin

items.text: There are two SUVs and a black pick up by restroom building setting up a big bbq grill. Only city/park vehicles are allowed in park grounds. They jumped the curb to enter illegally. Also, isn’t there a burn ban? Please remove these vehicles!

Thank you to the driver who made the extra passes to help clean rocks and debris from Brentwood Street this morning. Since the road was resurfaced, we have been buried in inches of loose rocks that pool at a low spot. We heard him coming, moved cars, and he noticed, making an extra slow pass to get as much as he could. We appreciate you!

Saw a truck pulled over in this spot and moving a storage shelf on a dolly into this trail just today. This has been a consistent problem over the years of easy access for the homeless to establish encampments into what used to be a great trail amenity that we pay for and used to enjoy. After many years of staying quiet I feel a need to report this to protect this amenity. Please don’t disregard.

There is a family of racoons that is now living between our backyard and our neighbors. Is there anything the city can do to help? We don’t want to harm the animals, but we do want to protect our dog. He has gotten into a fight with at least one of them and was not hurt. Thanks.

The traffic diversion the crews are doing on burnet right now are seriously dangerous. Road and lanes close without signage. None of this is marked in Google or Apple Maps. You need a project manager down here to clean up this.

More detection issues at the signal of Metric/Kramer for vehicles on EB Kramer. This signal routinely has detection issues and gets adjusted every time a report is made. Observed again between 5:38-5:45PM on 09/12/26. Please review historical timings and live video. This issue only impacts traffic on EB Kramer and causes a major backup of vehicles all the way to Braker and beyond. EB Kramer green

Reporting violation regarding the inhumane housing and welfare of chickens. The resident is keeping multiple birds confined on the lawn inside small, wire dog crates in the front yard (one bird in one crate, and two birds cramped together in another). This violates Austin City Code regarding basic requirements for adequate shelter and welfare. Please dispatch someone to ensure the wellbeing of the

Last Thursday park and rec mowers mowed all around the Veloway but did not blow the grass off the road which they have done in the past. Friday morning at dawn I came around this blind corner on my bike and slid on this grass they left on the road. 
It would be nice if they did not create dangerous situations. 
As you can see in the picture we cleaned up the problem they created. .

Illegal dumping and severe public right-of-way obstruction at the intersection corners and transit stop. A large sofa has been dumped on the sidewalk alongside heavily scattered litter, loose debris, and a campsite setup. This accumulation completely blocks pedestrian access and creates an unsafe obstruction for transit riders and disabled individuals trying to use the sidewalk and bus stop.

Dangerous temporary construction lane striping heading west on Cesar Chavez from I-35 approaching red river. There’s a white stripe leading you to a turn only lane instead of directly the 2 through lanes safely

Owner at 7801 Shoal Creek Blvd APT 101, Austin, TX 78757 has prohibited animals - birds, tortoise, fish - and refused building wide pest control treatment. Has a German roach infestation that is not being adequately addressed which is also impacting surrounding units.

Gravel and silt fencing stored at the end of Silk Oak Dr at the entrance to Silk Oak Park remaining from repaving Brodie Ln has been here for several weeks after the Brodie Ln work was completed. Need it cleaned up/removed.

Brush blocking bike lane on 38 1/2 St westbound (north side of street) from Red River to Duval, causing cyclists to have to veer into traffic to avoid branches. Trees, bushes, and grass need to be trimmed to the curb.

Watr is blasting bass for the second weekend in a row. It’s literally shaking our apartment… 

They had a DJ last night and the sound level was completely fine, so there’s no need for the bass to be this loud

Spotted these two dogs wandering together near the hospital this morning (Saturday, Sept. 12). They ran off and are still loose as far as I know.

One is tan/white and the other is dark brown, both with curly/spaniel-type coats. They appear to be traveling together.

No collar, ran away when approached. Last seen near st. David’s north surrounding medical complex

I am reporting an ongoing pattern of dogs being allowed off leash and/or inadequately controlled at my apartment complex. This is not an isolated incident. I have repeatedly encountered unleashed dogs while walking my own dog on the property, despite the property’s leash requirements.I have previously reported these concerns to property management and have retained emails, videos, dates, and other

Dog has been homeless for 5+ days and is now sleeping on my porch. It has a collar but no one in the neighborhood has claimed it. It ate my crocs. Neighbors said it goes back to his house sometimes but looks like the residents left and abandoned the dog. So sad

These neighbors moved on 2 weeks ago. And so did this turtle. 

I’m concerned about the turtle that is being kept on a balcony in a 20-gallon tank. The water appears very green and is only about 8 inches deep. Homeless encampment in bamboo, northeast end of Eastwoods Park (east side of wooded area along Sparks Avenue), north of 2-foot tall rock wall. Encampment is in bamboo, very near bedroom window of house adjacent to park, and dog barks at the encampment all night—regardless of whether dog is kept inside or outside the house. Horrid disturbance to everyone on the block.

Residential house seems to be running a car business and parks multiple junky cars on the road each week w/o plates. Often making it hard to see on Tallwood. Most cars are parked next to complex on Tallwood but residential house is on Camelia (Shown in location). They also often have a tow truck parked that tows said cars.

Driving on red River at 1 PM today, Wednesday, I was stopped at a red light at 41st St., then 45th St., then 51st St. In other words, the lights were not synchronized. I had the same problem heading south on red River at 11:30 AM the same day.

Fox remains are 3 feet from the sidewalk in front of 5673 Rain Creek Pkwy. 311 truck just came, parked for 3 mins, and drove away without taking the animal. It is right there. New picture and precise geolocation provided in images here.

This photo is at 5th and Walsh Street, looking south. 

There is no access available to either my businesses (Better Half Cafe and Hold Out Brewing).

This barricade is up 24/7 regardless of whether work is being done at the time.
Assembly hall has been shaking everyone’s houses in the neighborhood for 3 hours already. Can you please prioritize these previous complaints? Our children can’t fall asleep

Far out lounge causing disturbance to neighbourhood and surrounding area being impacted by people intoxicated and unable to get away. Multiple EMS being called to local area; management should take responsibility
Car is parked within 15 ft of intersection. This is illegal. Please stop dismissing this request. The car blocks the view and is unsafe. Please do your job.

Malfunctioning traffic light.  This traffic light cycles several times before giving west bound traffic a green light, leading to a large back up in traffic. When it does turn green, it is only green for a short time

Recurring outdoor amplified music being operated by a commercial venue that, according to prior 311 responses, is still seeking its OMV permit.

It’s almost 11:30 and their bass is driving us insane…

Chop shop still here and growing bigger by the day. Underneath wishbone bridge, under the western section of the bridge. People used to use this for fishing but no one can use this area while these people are here.

US 183 and Lake Creek - Light patterns will cause accidents.

The lake creek lights need to be red earlier. I may have dashcam video showing crossing traffic while I have a green.
